ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a distribution map of sea-level isobars. The legend on the right shows that the thick black line represents a "front," and the thin curves represent "isobars." The figure marks three locations, ①, ②, and ③, among which ① is located in the somewhat central part of the figure, ② is on the right side near 30°S and close to the front, and ③ is below ②, immediately near the thick black frontal line. Then reason: Near a front, air masses of different properties meet, and the air is easily forced to rise, often forming cloudy and rainy weather. Comparing the relationship between the three locations and the front, location ③ is most clearly located near the rain area affected by the front, so the one with overcast and rainy weather is location ③.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure below is a distribution map of sea-level isobars for a certain region. Read the figure and answer:<image1>

Which place in the figure has overcast and rainy weather?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有等压线、一个粗黑锋面符号以及①②③三个地点。根据图例确认粗黑线为锋面，再在图上定位各点与锋面的关系。利用“锋面附近空气抬升，常形成阴雨天气”的规则，选出位于锋面雨区的③地。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中为海平面等压线分布图，右侧图例显示粗黑线表示“锋面”，细曲线表示“等压线”。图中标有①、②、③三个地点，其中①位于图中偏中部，②在右侧接近30°S附近并靠近锋面，③位于②的下方，紧邻粗黑锋面线附近。再推理：锋面附近不同性质气团相遇，空气容易被迫抬升，常形成云雨天气。比较三个地点与锋面的关系，③地最明确位于锋面影响的雨区附近，因此为阴雨天气的是③地。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the legend on the right: the thick black line denotes a front and the thin curved lines denote isobars. In the map, compare the positions of ①、②、③ relative to the thick frontal line; ③ is located on/nearest the frontal zone, whereas ① is away from it and ② is not the main frontal rain position indicated.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to know the map is a sea-level isobar distribution map and the task is to identify which labeled place has rainy weather.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Frontal zones commonly produce uplift, clouds, and precipitation; areas away from fronts or in more stable pressure fields are less likely to have rainy weather. Therefore the labeled place on the front is the rainy one.
